Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane roadway in Houston, Texas, when Driver 2 moved into the same
lane without signaling and made contact with the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact produced a clear
sideswipe pattern, and the damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with the reported collision. Photographs
taken at the scene document the area of contact and the resting positions of both vehicles. No independent witnesses
were located, so the account rests on the statements of the drivers and the scene evidence. Responding officers
confirmed that Passenger was seated in the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash.
Driver 1 reported neck and back pain shortly after the collision and was evaluated at the scene. Officers found no
indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as an insured operator on the policy associated with the
vehicle. The injuries described are consistent with the type and force of the impact observed.
